Re: Offer of Employment — Director, Assay Development

Dear Ms. Adebayo-Fitch:

On behalf of Lumen Harbor Diagnostics, Inc. (the "Company"), I am pleased to offer you the position of Director, Assay Development, reporting to Dr. Wren Kowalczyk, Vice President of Research. This letter sets out the terms of our offer.

1. Start Date and Location.

Your anticipated start date is June 15, 2026. You will work primarily from the Company's Research Triangle Park facility, with the option to work remotely up to two days per week under the Company's flexible-work policy as it may change from time to time.

2. Base Salary.

Your annual base salary will be $218,000, less applicable withholdings, paid semi-monthly in accordance with the Company's regular payroll practices. Your salary will be reviewed annually, and any adjustment is at the Company's discretion.

3. Annual Bonus.

You will be eligible to participate in the Company's annual incentive plan with a target bonus of thirty percent (30%) of your base salary, prorated for your first partial year of service. Whether a bonus is paid, and in what amount, depends on Company and individual performance as determined by the Board or its Compensation Committee. You must be employed on the payment date to receive a bonus.

4. Equity.

Subject to approval by the Board, you will be granted an option to purchase 120,000 shares of the Company's Common Stock at an exercise price equal to the fair market value of a share on the grant date. The option will vest over four years, with twenty-five percent (25%) vesting on the first anniversary of your vesting commencement date and the remainder vesting in equal monthly installments over the following thirty-six months, subject to your continued service. The option is governed in all respects by the Company's 2024 Equity Incentive Plan and your grant documents, which control in the event of any inconsistency with this letter.

5. Benefits and Paid Time Off.

You will be eligible for the Company's medical, dental, vision, life, and disability plans, its 401(k) plan, and its other benefit programs, on the same terms as similarly situated employees and subject to the terms of the applicable plan documents. The Company may amend or terminate any benefit plan at any time. You will accrue paid time off under the Company's policy, currently at the rate of twenty (20) days per year, in addition to the Company's designated holidays.

6. Conditions of Employment.

This offer is contingent on: (a) your completion of the Company's employment application; (b) satisfactory results of a background check conducted in accordance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act, 15 U.S.C. § 1681b(b), for which you will receive a separate stand-alone disclosure and authorization; (c) your execution of the Company's Employee Confidentiality, Invention Assignment, and Non-Solicitation Agreement, a copy of which is enclosed for your review before you accept; and (d) your presentation of documentation establishing your identity and authorization to work in the United States, as required by the Immigration Reform and Control Act, within three business days of your start date.

7. No Conflicting Obligations.

By accepting this offer you represent that you are not subject to any employment, confidentiality, non-competition, or other agreement that would prevent you from accepting this position or performing its duties, and that you will not bring to the Company or use in your work any confidential information or trade secrets belonging to a former employer.

8. At-Will Employment.

Your employment with the Company is at will. This means that either you or the Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause and with or without notice. Nothing in this letter, in any Company policy, or in any statement by a Company representative creates a contract of employment for any specific period or limits the at-will relationship. The at-will nature of your employment may be changed only by a written agreement signed by you and the Chief Executive Officer of the Company.

9. Severance.

If the Company terminates your employment without Cause, and provided you sign and do not revoke a general release of claims in the form the Company then uses, the Company will pay you continued base salary for three (3) months following your termination date, paid on the Company's regular payroll schedule and subject to withholdings. This paragraph does not alter the at-will nature of your employment.

10. Company Policies.

You will be expected to comply with the Company's policies as they exist and may change, including its code of conduct, its anti-harassment and non-discrimination policies, and its policies on information security and the handling of protected health information under the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act.

11. Entire Agreement.

This letter, together with the agreements referenced in Section 6, is the complete statement of the terms of our offer and supersedes any prior discussions, representations, or offers, whether oral or written. It may be modified only in a writing signed by you and an authorized officer of the Company.

12. Governing Law.

This letter is governed by the laws of the State of North Carolina, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles.

If these terms are acceptable, please sign below and return this letter by May 15, 2026, after which this offer expires. We are excited about what you will bring to Lumen Harbor.

Sincerely,

/s/ Ezekiel Marchetti-Osei
Ezekiel Marchetti-Osei
Chief People Officer
Lumen Harbor Diagnostics, Inc.

ACCEPTED AND AGREED:

/s/ Oyelaran Adebayo-Fitch
